messages:
maya: Quick PRD intake — customer request around exposing model explainability flags and acceptance metrics for enterprise customers. Need to capture problem, goals, non-goals, success metrics, and clear acceptance criteria for launch gating. cc @samir @elena

samir: TL;DR — customers want toggles that include "why" tokens were generated (saliency) + a per-call quality score. Concern: perf and cost.

elena: we need concrete examples from the customer. Which workflows? Is this for embeddings, chat, or reranking?

maya: Primary use: legal doc assistant (chat). They want an explainability flag on responses that returns a light-weight token saliency map and an overall confidence score. Non-goal: full provenance or legal interpretation.

frank: question — is the "saliency map" something we compute at token level or sentence level? token-level could blow up payload sizes.

maya: start with sentence-level and a compact token-score summary. Customer asked for 95th percentile token budget <= 1.5x normal response size.

samir: perf notes — adding scoring will add ~20-40ms per response on dedicated infra (depends on model). Need opt-in and sampling + quota.

elena: propose acceptance criteria snippet:
```
- Feature behind customer flag in console and API param `explain=true`
- When enabled, response includes `explainability.summary` (string) and `explainability.sentence_scores` (array of floats)
- Payload size increase <= 1.5x for 95th pct when average response < 2048 tokens
- End-to-end p95 latency increase <= 50ms vs baseline for dedicated customers (opt-in)
- SDKs serialize explainability data in compact binary when requested
- Audit logs capture flag usage and user id
```

maya: success metrics: adoption by pilot customer (ACME Legal) for 2 weeks with <5% error rate, no SLO breaches, and product NPS >= +10 in pilot survey.

frank: edge cases — hallucinated explanations, inconsistent scores between repeated calls, and rate-limiting when customers enable for high throughput.

samir: rollout plan idea — beta for dedicated customers only, default off. Canary: 1 host, ramp 1->10% traffic, monitor p95 latency, token costs, and explainability-vector variance.

maya: risks & mitigations: cost bump -> quota and sampling; privacy -> do not log raw input when explainability enabled unless customer explicitly opts in. Add KMS flag for storage.

elena: asks for acceptance test placeholders: integration test to assert fields exist; perf test to assert p95 delta; regression harness to verify explanation stability across model patch.

maya: assigning owners: maya (PM), elena (SWE), samir (infra perf), frank (SDK). I'll draft a short PRD doc after we align on criteria. :thumbsup: 

samir: +1. I'll gather perf numbers from the runtime and paste here tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Note: scheduled deploy window 03/22 02:00-04:00 UTC — changes requiring infra can be slotted after approval.

frank: I'll start a small SDK prototype for compact encoding.

maya: thanks all — leaving this thread open for any further acceptance criteria or edge cases. Filing as PRD stub in docs after this.
